1.0.0.en: Updated to SDK 3. Added Insights support. Device tile dims when connection is not available.

1.0.2.en: Changing the port number no longer requires a restart of the app to take effect. The online and offline flow cards where reversed for the TCP device.

2.0.0.en: Changed the App ID so it can be published in the Athom store. Changed the capability to an alarm to conform with guidelines

2.0.2.en: Reorganised old code to reduce memory usage

2.0.3.en: Added Log viewer to Configure App page

2.0.4.en: Fix Send Log feature. Fixed issue where polling could stop on a successful connection.

2.0.5.en: Changed to use error.code instead of error.errno ready for new Homey firmware.

2.0.6.en: Added a settings to specify the number of checks that timeout before a device goes offline.

2.0.7.en: Fix issue with the number of checks being ignored for a timeout.

2.0.8.en: Fixed 'Invert' option on 'Is OnLine' condition card. Deprecated 'Is Offline' condition card.

2.0.9.en: Added German translations thanks to Dirk Göbel

2.1.0.en: Added ARP-first reachability, Probe Time Insights, duration Flow conditions and connection-tested pairing; improved status compatibility and logging, and removed Send Log and many others updates, details on forum.

2.1.1.en: Added ARP-first reachability, Probe Time Insights, duration Flow conditions and connection-tested pairing; improved status compatibility and logging, and removed Send Log and many others updates, details on forum.

2.1.2.en: Fixed stale probe times by clearing the value immediately when a probe fails and restoring it on the next successful check.

2.1.3.en: Added “Check now” Flow actions for IP and TCP devices and fixed the missing reachable quick-action listener after upgrades.

2.1.4.en: Fixed missing Flow token translations and reduced the minimum device check interval to 5 seconds.

2.1.5.en: Reduced the minimum check timeout to 1 second and clarified the delay-between-checks setting.
